blocks.text: The Application Map visualizes network data in your organization. It provides a high-level view of how resource groups and their connected resources are performing, as well as options to view each group in detail.
To view the Application Map, from the navigation menu, go to Zero Trust Cloud > Dashboard > Microsegmentation Application Map.
You can use the search function to quickly locate a specific resource group on the map. The Application Map also supports the following filters for targeted data analysis:

blocks.item: Time Range: Filter data based on a specific time range, up to 14 days in the past.
AppZone: Filter data based on a specific AppZone. To learn more, see About AppZones.
Group By: Filter data by resource groups or virtual private clouds (VPCs) and virtual networks (VNETs).
Resource Group: Filter data based on a single resource group. You can reset the filter to load all resource groups for viewing on the map.

blocks.text: You can click the Question icon to leverage keyboard shortcuts for quickly navigating and reading the map. To view the legacy version of the Application Map, click the Filter icon.
The map supports both dark and light modes. To select your preferred mode, see Customizing Your Account Settings.
The Application Map provides information about the following:

blocks.item: Managed Resource Groups (denoted with the M icon)
Unmanaged Resource Groups (denoted with the UM icon)

blocks.text: You can click a resource group to open a drawer containing its details. Additionally, when you click on a resource group, the map displays information about the group's managed and unmanaged flows, and if applicable, provides the option to review policy recommendations for the resource group based on those flows.
To learn more about reviewing policy recommendations for resource groups, see About Policy Recommendations for Resource Groups and Reviewing Policy Recommendations for Resource Groups.
